DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis

The description of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on your dorsal hand is highly characteristic of Actinic Keratosis, a precancerous lesion caused by cumulative sun exposure. Given your history of regular sunbathing, this fits perfectly. I will now request a dermatoscopic image of the lesion to confirm the diagnosis and rule out squamous cell carcinoma.
